questions.question: Explain contrasting Catholic and Muslim views on contraception.

points.text: The Catholic Church forbids all artificial contraception, teaching that every sexual act must remain open to procreation. Only natural family planning is permitted. In contrast, most Muslim scholars permit contraception — the Qur'an does not forbid it, and Muhammad did not prevent his companions from practising coitus interruptus.
